tool.name: Get Gmail Message Metadata
tool.description: Retrieve message metadata including headers, labels, and snippet without downloading the full message body. Use this for efficient message inspection before deciding whether to retrieve full content.

headers.description: Optional array of specific header names to retrieve (e.g., ['From', 'To', 'Subject', 'Date']). If omitted, returns common headers.

messageId.description: The ID of the message to retrieve metadata for
